description: Defines a span class template for referencing contiguous sequences, including constructors, accessors, and formatting support. Contains internal traits for type compatibility and custom formatters for span and vector types.

classes.name: ocudu::span
classes.description: A template class representing a view over a contiguous sequence of elements, with constructors, element access, and subspan operations.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the span.

methods.name: size_bytes
methods.description: Returns the size of the span in bytes.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the span is empty.

methods.name: front
methods.description: Returns a reference to the first element.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Returns a reference to the last element.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses element at a given index.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the underlying data.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the first element.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to the element following the last.

methods.name: rbegin
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to the first element.

methods.name: rend
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to the element following the last.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns a span over the first 'count' elements.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns a span over the last 'count' elements.

methods.name: subspan
methods.description: Returns a span over a subrange starting at 'offset' with length 'count'.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two spans have the same elements.
